name: Brambleghast
description: Brambleghast, the Tumbleweed Pokémon, and the evolved form of Bramblin. A Grass and Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.
Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.
